svg.text: For a C3 POWER-LEFT module only
Hold the module USB up, chip facing you: 5V, G and 3V3 must be the top
three pins of the LEFT row. A power-right module here puts 5 V on a
GPIO pin and can destroy it. Check before you plug U1 in.
RP1 100 kΩ: B10, bottom − rail at
RP2 100 kΩ: B13, bottom − rail at
RSD1 10 kΩ: top + rail at number 14,
I14; fit only if the amplifier's SD
pin reads near 0 V in the SD pull-up
U1 ESP32-C3 Super Mini: D1-D8, H1-H8
copper strip: its holes are joined
a part on the board (see Parts)
a wire of an off-board device (see Device wires)
unmarked edge trace, broken at the link pads beside the M3 holes; the links join the halves
leave open: fitting a link here would join two rail halves that carry different nets (see the build steps)
DNP: a part fitted only when needed (see the build list); keep its holes free
a wire laid along the centre channel (no copper there), under U1 where drawn
20 mm: printed at 100 % (actual size) this bar measures 20 mm and the board is real size
